statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous monitoring is required to assess arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation therapy.
CPT code 93229 was billed for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study.
Diagnosis codes I48.0, R00.2, and Z86.73 were submitted.
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204.
The submitted materials do not align with the records currently maintained in the insurer's system.
